notes.title: Demo Update 1.00.03
notes.content:
Changes:
[list]
[*] Title screen fix for users reporting that the only the background image was appearing
[*] Added a Mac Build (currently built to 1.00.02)
[/list]

A temporary fix of pressing "Enter" on the title screen will additionally start the game for now. Please let me know if there are still issues reaching the game. (Might need a fresh install on Steam)

- Alvin (Lead Programmer)

notes.title: Demo Update 1.00.02
notes.content:
Changes:
[list]
[*] Added FPS options in Visual Settings
[*] Fixed typos in Words and Story
[*] Pause Menu has been partially revamped and properly remembers options
[*] Fix volume controls issue at 0
[*] Fix Resolution option not being clickable
[*] Add versioning to main menu and pause
[*] Compressed game to be much smaller than before
[/list]

Dev Blurb:
Thank you everyone for all the support and reports! It has been amazing seeing all the art, theories, suggestions and discourse about the game! You guys rock!!!

The focus for the next update will be: 
[list]
[*] Save Functionality
[*] Further investigation on game breaking bugs
[*] A proper credits page
[/list]

- Alvin (Lead Programmer)
